title: Creative Projects got a clearer, larger showcase
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: more community projects on display, clearer front-page signals, and better contributor rails.

The Creative Projects page now explains itself with a “What is this?” entry and adds Imagine Draw AI, Aimpress, and Evolve AI to the growing list of things people are building with pollinations.

Front-page statistics were restored, text generation rates were corrected, and the project showcase picked up Discord bot, GitHub stars, and documentation updates. Numbers and links: software's preferred way of proving it exists.

Claude Code workflow support and a claude.md guide were added to the repository, giving contributors clearer rails for working with the codebase.
